body.zh: 尼泊尔当局在因天气原因短暂暂停后恢复搜救工作，在一场造成数百人死亡并席卷西藏边境地区的毁灭性洪水之后，寻找近 3,000 名失踪人员。 周六，一名下落不明的悉尼女子，26 岁的卡拉·塞维里诺 (Cara Severino) 与她的父母取得了联系，随后澳大利亚领事官员安全找到了她。 外交部长黄英贤表示，这是“在一场带来巨大损失和不确定性的灾难中罕见的积极消息”。 “我对那些仍然失踪的人的家人感到同情——我知道我的家人和朋友经历了多少，”她说。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 “我很幸运来自澳大利亚，并得到大使馆和澳大利亚政府的大力支持。” 周三，冰川崩塌引发岩石、冰块、泥浆和碎片涌入山区河流系统，造成尼泊尔至少 669 人死亡、中国西藏至少 7 人死亡，造成 41 名澳大利亚人下落不明。 目前仍有近3000人失踪，其中尼泊尔约2426人，西藏吉隆县约554人，其中至少有540名外国人，其中许多是来自印度的印度教朝圣者。 尼泊尔已呼吁提供专门的外国援助，其财政部长表示，重建需要高达 50 亿美元（70 亿美元）的资金。 受灾严重的拉苏瓦地区一名警官表示，搜救行动因雨和雾而暂时停止，并于周日下午恢复。 “直升机正在飞行，天气有所好转后，行动也恢复了，”他不愿透露姓名，因为他无权接受媒体采访。 周五，洪水发生后，尼泊尔和中国边境形成的一个湖泊开始溢出，流入尼泊尔的伦德科拉河和特里苏利河，当局还暂停了救援工作。 中国当局和中央电视台表示，到周六，风险已经缓解，部分湖床清晰可见。据中央电视台报道，卫星图像显示湖水正在慢慢流失，湖面逐渐缩小。 该湖是尼泊尔正在监测的洪水区上游的两个湖之一。一位官员警告说，在两者完全排干之前，洪水风险将持续存在。 灾难发生三天后，当局表示，一些被打捞出来的尸体已经腐烂得面目全非。由于健康风险和对疾病爆发的恐惧，他们将在办理法律手续后被埋葬。 奇特旺地区政府在一份通知中表示，“将收集 DNA 样本，并将尸体埋在露天场所。” 失踪澳大利亚人的几名家人和朋友已飞往尼泊尔......

reflection.en: In the midst of devastating floods in Nepal and Tibet, the news of Cara Severino's safe return offers a glimmer of hope. This story reminds us of the profound uncertainty faced by families during disasters, and the importance of advocating for the vulnerable, ensuring no one is forgotten in the chaos.
reflection.zh: 在尼泊尔和西藏毁灭性洪水肆虐之际，卡拉·塞韦里诺安全获救的消息带来了一线希望。这个故事提醒我们，在灾难中，家属们面临着巨大的不确定性，以及为弱势群体发声、确保混乱中无人被遗忘的重要性。

verse.textEn: Speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves, for the rights of all who are destitute. Speak up and judge fairly; defend the rights of the poor and needy.
verse.textZh: 你当为不能自辩的开口，为孤独的伸冤。你当开口按公义判断，为困苦和穷乏的辨屈。

title.en: Death toll from Nepal-Tibet floods rises to over 600
title.zh: 尼泊尔-西藏洪灾死亡人数升至600多人

summary.en: Heavy rain is complicating an already difficult rescue effort, as hundreds remain missing three days after deadly flash floods hit the Nepal-Tibet border region. The latest death toll from the devastating flash flood along the Nepal-Tibet border was reported on Saturday to be over 600, as frantic rescue operations to...
summary.zh: 致命的山洪袭击尼泊尔-西藏边境地区三天后，大雨使本已艰难的救援工作更加复杂，仍有数百人失踪。据报道，周六尼泊尔-西藏边境地区毁灭性山洪的最新死亡人数已超过600人，搜寻数百名失踪人员的紧急救援行动进入第四天。根据尼泊尔灾害机构的数据，尼泊尔的死亡人数现已达到626人，包括外国人在内的2,426人仍然失踪。在边境另一侧的...

body.en:
Heavy rain is complicating an already difficult rescue effort, as hundreds remain missing three days after deadly flash floods hit the Nepal-Tibet border region.

The latest death toll from the devastating flash flood along the Nepal-Tibet border was reported on Saturday to be over 600, as frantic rescue operations to search for hundreds of missing people entered a fourth day.

Figures from both countries put the number of missing close to 3,000, with 682 bodies recovered and reports of corpses swept as far downstream as India.

According to Nepal 's disaster agency, the death toll there now stands at 675, with 2,426 people — including foreigners — still missing.

Across the border in Tibet, China's state news agency, Xinhua, has confirmed seven deaths and reported 554 missing individuals.

A glacial collapse on Wednesday sent rock, ice, mud and debris surging through the Himalayan mountain river systems below.

The flood swept through areas near the Chinese border, ravaging entire towns and damaging hydropower plants.

Nepal army spokesperson Raja Ram Basnet told the media on Saturday that helicopter operations were on hold until the weather improved.

Rescuers are battling thick layers of mud in the affected areas, which is making it difficult for helicopters to land and take off.

The army has located people trapped in a tunnel of the Trishuli 3A hydropower project in Nepal's Rasuwa District. Over 100 people are believed to be inside the tunnel filled with mud.

Basnet said that rescuers were struggling to locate the entry points of the tunnel and had made use of  baskets and ropes to reach some people. There are also limited places for helicopters to land in the area.

On Friday, Nepal's Army shared visuals of some people being rescued from the tunnel. The survivors were seen stuck in the mud, while officials crawled through the sludge and held out their hands to them.

On Saturday, Foreign Minister Shishir Khanal said a specialized tunnel rescue team had arrived from neighboring India and was ready to start work.

Nepalese authorities said the bodies of many flood victims have also been found dozens of kilometers from the disaster zone in Chitwan District in southern Nepal, which borders India.

Meanwhile, Indian authorities said they recovered the bodies of seven people who were swept downstream from Nepal and believe them to be flood victims.

Late on Friday, Nepal's Foreign Minister Shisir Khanal told the Reuters news agency that his country needed equipment, along with technical knowledge in tunnel rescue operations.

Khanal also told Reuters that Nepal did not need help with search and rescue operations but needed assistance in opening transport and communication lines in places...
body.zh: 大雨使本已困难的救援工作变得更加复杂，在致命的山洪袭击尼泊尔和西藏边境地区三天后，仍有数百人失踪。 周六，据报道尼泊尔-西藏边境毁灭性山洪造成的最新死亡人数已超过 600 人，搜寻数百名失踪人员的疯狂救援行动已进入第四天。 据尼泊尔救灾机构称，尼泊尔目前死亡人数为 626 人，仍有 2,426 人失踪，其中包括外国人。 在边境另一边的西藏，中国官方通讯社新华社已确认 7 人死亡，并报告了 554 人失踪。 周三的冰川崩塌使岩石、冰、泥土和碎片涌入下面的喜马拉雅山区河流系统。 洪水席卷了中国边境附近的地区，摧毁了整个城镇并损坏了水电站。 尼泊尔陆军发言人拉贾·拉姆·巴斯内特 (Raja Ram Basnet) 周六对媒体表示，直升机行动暂停，直至天气好转。 救援人员正在受影响地区与厚厚的泥浆作斗争，这使得直升机难以着陆和起飞。 尼泊尔拉苏瓦地区Trishuli 3A水电项目隧道内，军队已找到被困人员。据信，隧道内有超过 100 人，里面充满了泥土。 巴斯内特说，救援人员正在努力找到隧道的入口点，并使用篮子和绳索来救助一些人。该地区直升机的降落地点也有限。 周五，尼泊尔军队分享了一些人从隧道中被救出的画面。人们看到幸存者被困在泥里，而官员们则爬过污泥并向他们伸出双手。 尼泊尔当局表示，在与印度接壤的尼泊尔南部奇旺地区，距离灾区数十公里的地方也发现了许多洪水遇难者的尸体。 与此同时，印度当局表示，他们找到了从尼泊尔下游被冲走的七人的尸体，并认为他们是洪水受害者。 周五晚些时候，尼泊尔外交部长希西尔·卡纳尔告诉路透社，尼泊尔需要设备以及隧道救援行动的技术知识。 卡纳尔还告诉路透社，尼泊尔不需要搜救行动方面的帮助，但需要援助来开通桥梁被毁地区的交通和通讯线路、尸体身份识别、DNA测试以及尸体的长期储存。 路透社援引卡纳尔的话称：“我们已经在我们没有足够专业知识和技术知识的领域提出了此类专业服务和技术援助的请求。”

reflection.en: The devastating flash floods along the Nepal-Tibet border, leaving over 600 dead and hundreds missing, bring immense sorrow. In moments of such profound loss, the shortest verse in the Bible, "Jesus wept," reminds us that grief is a deeply human and even divine response to suffering and death. Our hearts go out to the families in the Nepal-Tibet border...
reflection.zh: 尼泊尔-西藏边境地区毁灭性的山洪造成600多人死亡，数百人失踪，带来了巨大的悲痛。在如此深重的损失面前，圣经中最短的经文“雅伟哭了”提醒我们，悲伤是对苦难和死亡的一种深刻的人性甚至神性的回应。我们的心与尼泊尔-西藏边境地区那些正在应对这场悲剧的家庭同在。

verse.textEn: Jesus wept.
verse.textZh: 耶稣哭了。

title.en: Footage of Tibet floods isn't being shown in China - and we know little about victims there
title.zh: 西藏洪水画面未在中国境内播放，受害者信息鲜为人知

summary.en: Dramatic footage of deadly flash flooding in Tibet, specifically at Gyirong Port, which swept away everything in its path and claimed hundreds of lives, has been largely hidden from public view and censored on the internet within China.
summary.zh: 西藏吉隆口岸发生致命山洪，洪水冲毁一切，造成数百人死亡，但相关震撼画面和信息在中国境内被大量隐藏，并在互联网上受到审查。

body.en:
The dramatic footage was almost impossible to miss. A torrent of water tearing through Gyirong Port, one of the main border crossings between Nepal and Tibet, sweeping away all in its path as hundreds of people fled for their lives.

The scenes, captured by CCTV cameras, quickly spread on social media and onto screens around the world.

Only a single still-frame shot has been broadcast so far by the country's state-run flagship news bulletin.

It has also been difficult to find the full video on China's heavily censored internet. Although various aspects of the disaster have been discussed online.

But what is even harder to find is any first-hand accounts of survivors describing the flash flooding that has claimed hundreds of lives, with just as many still unaccounted for since Wednesday.

Beijing has launched a massive rescue operation involving hundreds of emergency workers, which is continuing, and President Xi Jinping chaired an emergency meeting with officials to co-ordinate efforts.

But when you compare the country's internet content to what much of the world has been seeing online these past few days, China's firewall becomes more visible than ever.

Tibet, which Beijing annexed in the 1950s, had long resisted rule by the Chinese Communist Party.

China has quashed protests over the years, sometimes violently, and has been accused of grave rights violations in the Buddhist region. It has labelled the exiled spiritual leader, the Dalai Lama, a separatist.

That history means the very name Tibet draws China's censors. Beijing's sensitivities are especially apparent at times likes this.

There have been daily updates on the missing and the dead, and Beijing has also been posting updates on the rescue operations, as well as the dangers posed by a barrier lake that has been at risk of overflowing.

On Saturday, new footage from Chinese state media showed rescue teams wandering in a wasteland of mud and rock while calling out to anyone trapped.

But there is little detail beyond that. There are no accounts from survivors in Tibet, and almost no user-generated footage showing the deadly moments or their aftermath.

We are yet to hear from anxious families of those missing. Trying to contact people there is near-impossible during regular times.

As a journalist who has covered North Korea, it has often been easier for me to contact interviewees in Pyongyang than it is in the Tibetan capital, Lhasa.

On Thursday night, as global headlines led on the devastation in a Himalayan valley, China's state broadcaster opened its main bulletin with the launch of Xi's new book, a selection of his "most important and fundamental works".

Foreign journalists cannot travel to Tibet without government permission. We have just a few hours to get as much information...
body.zh: 戏剧性的镜头几乎不可能被错过。尼泊尔和西藏之间的主要边境口岸之一吉隆口岸发生洪流，洪水冲垮了沿途的一切，数百人逃命。 这些场景被闭路电视摄像机捕捉到，迅速在社交媒体和世界各地的屏幕上传播。 到目前为止，该国官方旗舰新闻公报只播放了一个静态画面。 在中国严格审查的互联网上也很难找到这段视频。同样很难找到描述这场夺去了数百人生命的山洪的帖子，自周三以来仍有同样多的人下落不明。 北京已启动了涉及数百名应急人员的大规模救援行动，该行动仍在继续，国家主席习近平主持召开了官员紧急会议，协调救援行动。 但当你将中国的互联网内容与过去几天世界上大部分地区在网上看到的内容进行比较时，中国的防火墙变得比以往任何时候都更加明显。 北京在 20 世纪 50 年代吞并的西藏长期以来一直反抗中国共产党的统治。 多年来，中国镇压了抗议活动，有时甚至是暴力镇压，并被指控在佛教地区严重侵犯人权。它给流亡精神领袖达赖喇嘛贴上了分离主义者的标签。 这段历史意味着中国审查机构用“西藏”这个名字来命名。北京的敏感性在这种时候尤其明显。 每天都有关于失踪和死亡的最新消息，北京也一直在发布救援行动的最新消息，以及堰塞湖面临溢出风险所带来的危险。 周六，中国官方媒体的新镜头显示，救援队在一片泥泞和岩石的荒地上徘徊，同时向被困人员呼救。 但除此之外就没有什么细节了。没有西藏幸存者的叙述，也几乎没有用户生成的视频显示致命时刻或后果。 我们还没有收到失踪者焦急的家人的消息。平时想要联系那里的人几乎是不可能的。 作为一名报道朝鲜的记者，我在平壤联系受访者往往比在西藏首府拉萨更容易。 周四晚上，当全球头条新闻报道喜马拉雅山谷的灾难时，中国国家广播公司以习近平新书的发布作为其主要公报的开篇，该书精选了他的“最重要和最基础的著作”。 未经政府许可，外国记者不得前往西藏。在视频被删除、声音被压制之前，我们只有几个小时的时间来尽可能多地获取有关此类重大事件的信息。 相反，我们必须依靠...

reflection.en: The tragic flash flooding in Tibet, particularly at Gyirong Port, has left hundreds dead or unaccounted for, yet dramatic footage and details remain largely hidden from the Chinese public. Proverbs 31:8 calls us to open our mouths for the mute, reminding us of the moral imperative to acknowledge and amplify the suffering of the vulnerable. Even when...
reflection.zh: 西藏吉隆口岸的洪水灾情造成数百人死亡或失踪，然而，相关的震撼画面和详细信息在中国公众面前却被大量隐藏。箴言31:8呼吁我们为不能发声的人开口，提醒我们有道德责任去承认并放大弱势群体的苦难。即使信息被压制，受苦者的呼声依然回荡，敦促我们为他们的困境发出同情和声音。

verse.textEn: Speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves, for the rights of all who are destitute. Speak up and judge fairly; defend the rights of the poor and needy.
verse.textZh: 你当为不能自辩的开口，为孤独的伸冤。你当开口按公义判断，为困苦和穷乏的辨屈。

title.en: Satellite images reveal scale of flood devastation in Nepal villages
title.zh: 卫星图像揭示尼泊尔村庄洪灾破坏规模

summary.en: Satellite imagery has revealed the scale of devastation along Nepal's Trishuli River following a deadly flash flood triggered by a glacier collapse on Wednesday. The torrent destroyed villages, bridges, and a key Nepal-Tibet border crossing, leaving hundreds dead and thousands missing.
summary.zh: 卫星图像揭示了周三因冰川坍塌引发的特大山洪对尼泊尔特里舒利河沿岸造成的破坏规模。洪流摧毁了村庄、桥梁和尼泊尔与西藏之间的一个关键边境口岸，造成数百人死亡，数千人失踪。

body.en:
New satellite imagery has revealed the scale of the devastation along Nepal's Trishuli River caused by Wednesday's deadly flash flood, triggered by a glacier collapse.

Before-and-after images show how sections of the valley, where a torrent of floodwater and debris surged through, destroyed villages, bridges and hydroelectric power stations.

Hundreds of people have been killed and thousands more are missing, Nepalese officials say.

Among the worst-hit locations reviewed by BBC Verify was a key Nepal-Tibet border crossing, which was engulfed by a rush of floodwater and captured on camera.

The satellite imagery from US-based intelligence firm Vantor, shows the site has been almost entirely washed away. Shocking CCTV footage showed the moment as the deluge of water swept over buildings as people tried to escape.

Damage and mud can be seen more than 2.5km (1.5 miles) upstream, reaching 100m (330 ft) above the area it first hit.

A few miles further south is the village of Timure, which has now largely disappeared.

The walls of the valley at this point are steep, reaching up to 50m above the water line. The image shows most of the houses perched on this slope are now gone or covered in mud.

A further 10km (eight miles) downstream, where the Trishuli River winds through Syapru Besi, satellite imagery now shows the village covered by mud, rock and other debris. Houses and other structures have disappeared, including bridges and a hydroelectric power station.

One of the larger villages to be struck by the full force of the flood was Trishuli, where some of the earliest verified footage of the disaster emerged from.

A satellite image of the town and surrounding agricultural land, which is about 45km (28 miles) downstream from the border, show an entire neighbourhood has been essentially washed away.

Verified videos of the town show a bridge collapsing as the river surges forward. At the very same moment from ground level, footage filmed from inside a bus shows people crying out in distress and trying to flee as they see the water rushing down the river.

Other dramatic videos show people sheltering inside a house, peering over the edge of a balcony as they watch a torrent of floodwater wash away almost everything around them, knocking large metal debris and a vehicle toward the building.

Somehow the house remains intact and survivors can be seen in a second verified video standing surrounded by mud once the floodwater had receded.

Imagery from satellite provider Planet Labs released today has also provided a clearer view of the disaster's origins at the collapsed glacier, the moment of which has been captured on a verified drone video.

The satellite image shows an enormous chunk of the glacier has fallen away, carving an enormous path of rock...
body.zh: 新的卫星图像揭示了周三冰川崩塌引发的致命山洪对尼泊尔特里苏利河沿岸造成的破坏规模。 前后照片显示了洪水和瓦砾汹涌而过的山谷部分地区如何摧毁了村庄、桥梁和水力发电站。 尼泊尔官员称，数百人死亡，数千人失踪。 BBC verify 审查的受灾最严重的地点之一是尼泊尔和西藏的一个重要过境点，该过境点被洪水淹没，并被摄像机拍摄到。 美国情报公司 Vantor 的卫星图像显示，该地点几乎完全被冲毁。令人震惊的闭路电视画面显示，当人们试图逃离时，洪水席卷建筑物。 在上游超过 2.5 公里（1.5 英里）处可以看到损坏和泥浆，到达其首次袭击区域上方 100 m（330 英尺）。 再往南几英里是蒂穆尔村，该村现已基本消失。 此时的山谷壁很陡，高出水线高达 50m。该图像显示，坐落在这个斜坡上的大多数房屋现在都已经消失或被泥土覆盖。 再往下游 10 公里（8 英里）处，Trishuli 河蜿蜒穿过 Syapru Besi，卫星图像现在显示该村庄被泥土、岩石和其他碎片覆盖。房屋和其他建筑物都消失了，包括桥梁和水力发电站。 Trishuli是遭受洪水全面袭击的较大村庄之一，一些最早经过核实的灾难镜头就来自那里。 该镇及周边农田（距离边境下游约 45 公里（28 英里））的卫星图像显示，整个社区基本上已被冲走。 经核实的该镇视频显示，随着河流汹涌澎湃，一座桥梁倒塌。就在同一时刻，从地面拍摄的公交车内拍摄的视频显示，人们看到河水顺流而下，痛苦地呼喊并试图逃跑。 其他戏剧性的视频显示，人们躲在房子里，从阳台边缘往外看，看到洪水冲走了他们周围的几乎所有东西，将大块金属碎片和一辆汽车冲向建筑物。 不知何故，房子仍然完好无损，在第二段经过验证的视频中可以看到洪水退去后幸存者被泥土包围。 卫星提供商 Planet Labs 今天发布的图像也提供了冰川崩塌灾难起源的更清晰视图，经过验证的无人机视频捕捉到了这一瞬间。 卫星图像显示，一大块冰川已经消失，形成了一条巨大的岩石道路……

reflection.en: The images of the Trishuli River valley being engulfed by debris remind us of the 'groaning' of a world subject to sudden, overwhelming natural forces. As we see homes and vital crossings washed away, we are confronted with the fragility of our earthly structures and the deep grief of those who have lost everything. We look to Yahweh to be near the...
reflection.zh: 特里舒利河谷被瓦砾和洪流吞没的景象提醒我们，受造之物在面对突如其来的巨大自然力量时正处于“叹息劳苦”之中。当我们看到家园和关键通道被冲走，我们直面人类建筑的脆弱以及那些失去一切的人们深重的悲哀。我们仰望雅伟，祈求祂亲近尼泊尔那些伤心的人，并为正在进行的搜救工作提供力量。

verse.textEn: We know that the whole creation has been groaning as in the pains of childbirth right up to the present time.
verse.textZh: 我们知道，一切受造之物一同叹息、劳苦，直到如今。

title.en: How Australians can help those impacted by devastating Nepal floods
title.zh: 澳大利亚人如何帮助受尼泊尔毁灭性洪水影响的人们

summary.en: Australian charities have launched a joint appeal to aid communities devastated by floods and landslides along the Nepal-China border. Thousands are in urgent need of shelter, food, clean water, and medical care after their homes and infrastructure were destroyed.
summary.zh: 澳大利亚慈善机构已发起联合募捐，以援助尼泊尔-中国边境受洪水和山体滑坡摧毁的社区。在房屋和基础设施被毁后，成千上万的人迫切需要住所、食物、清洁饮用水和医疗援助。

body.en:
Entire communities have been devastated by severe flooding and landslides along the Nepal-Tibet border, with homes, roads, bridges and critical infrastructure destroyed.

Search and rescue operations remain underway, while thousands of people are in urgent need of shelter, food, clean drinking water and medical assistance.

In response, 14 Australian charities have joined forces to launch a national appeal.

The Emergency Action Alliance (EAA) has launched the Nepal Flood Disaster Appeal, bringing together a variety of charities to support communities affected by the disaster.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

The alliance says donations will help provide immediate humanitarian assistance, including emergency shelter, food, safe drinking water, hygiene supplies and medical care.

Access to some affected communities remains difficult, with damaged roads and ongoing weather conditions hampering efforts to reach people in need.

Australians are encouraged to donate through the EAA website or by calling 1300 939 000.

The charities participating in the appeal are Save the Children Australia, Plan International Australia, Oxfam Australia, Australia for UNHCR, ActionAid Australia, CARE Australia, Caritas Australia, ADRA, Act for Peace, Anglican Overseas Aid, Australian Lutheran World Service, Baptist World Aid Australia, CBM Australia and Tearfund Australia.

EAA executive director Kerren Morris said the appeal provided Australians with a trusted way to support people affected by the disaster.

"Emergency shelter, food, safe drinking water and medical support are urgently needed now, while longer-term recovery efforts will continue for many months," she said in a statement.

The charities involved bring different areas of humanitarian expertise to the response, with organisations and their local partners working to provide immediate assistance to affected communities.

Save the Children is focusing on supporting children and families affected by humanitarian emergencies.

Oxfam Australia's humanitarian work includes support for essential services such as clean water, sanitation and emergency assistance.

Australia for UNHCR is the UN refugee agency's national partner in Australia, and is supporting humanitarian assistance through the UNHCR network.

The charities involved are continuing to assess the scale of the disaster and humanitarian needs in affected communities.

The EAA says its members are working to determine where support is most urgently needed as search and rescue operations continue.

The appeal has been endorsed by the Australian Council for International Development (ACFID), the peak body for Australian non-government organisations...

title.en: The online privacy change that could give Australians more control over their data
title.zh: 在线隐私的变化可以让澳大利亚人更好地控制自己的数据

summary.en: The privacy reforms are also expected to strengthen protections around AI and smart glasses.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自澳洲栏目的新闻，重点涉及真理、分辨与诚实。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
Australians could soon force social media companies to destroy their personal information under an overhaul of privacy laws.

Attorney-General Michelle Rowland will on Monday unveil plans for extra protections for people online, including the right to erasure.

The policy would mean social media users can request tech companies delete their personal information published online or held by the platforms.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

"The right to erasure will help put more control in the hands of Australians, allowing personal information to be destroyed from large digital platforms," she said.

"We must ensure appropriate safeguards are placed around technology and stop the erosion of our privacy protections."

The privacy reforms are also expected to contain measures to strengthen protections around AI and smart glasses.

Rowland had ordered the privacy commissioner in August to investigate whether extra regulations were needed for the glasses.

Concerns had been raised about their use to record people without their knowledge or consent following cheap versions hitting the market.

It comes as the federal government moves to roll out extra protections for identity documents online.

A service called IDLock will allow people to block or unblock the use of identity documents such as passports.

IDLock will be made available through the government's MyGov platform from 2027 after a small-scale trial in late 2026.

"Australians deserve to have control over how their personal identity information, such as their driver licence or passport, is used to verify their identity online," Rowland said.

"As data breaches, scams and cyber-enabled crime continue to evolve, Australia's approach must evolve with them."

IDLock was developed as a way for people to access the security of the Credential Protection Register.

The register was set up by the federal government in 2022 to stop ID documents being used in identity fraud.

title.zh: 澳大利亚拳击巨星托尼·芒丁去世，享年 75 岁

summary.en: Mundine was the father of former boxer and NRL player Anthony Mundine and grandfather to boxer Rahim Mundine.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自澳洲栏目的新闻，重点涉及和平与克制。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
The father of former boxer and NRL star Anthony Mundine succumbed to a heart attack on Sunday.

Born in Baryulgil, near Grafton in northern NSW, Tony Mundine was the first Australian to fight in four different weight divisions, challenging for the world middleweight title against Argentina's Carlos Monzon in 1974, in a bout stopped in the seventh round.

Mundine leaves a significant boxing legacy. Anthony was an IBO middleweight and WBA super-middleweight world champion, whose son Rahim won his fourth career fight from as many professional bouts on the Gold Coast only last week.

Anthony Mundine posted a tribute to his father on social media, saying he was returning home for his funeral after travelling to Saudi Arabia.

"Thanks for doing all you did for me and supporting me in every moment, showing love and strength gonna miss you Tonza, there's only one Tony Mundine."

Through a career in the middleweight, light-heavyweight, cruiserweight and heavyweight divisions, Tony Mundine recorded 80 wins — 64 from knockouts, 15 losses, and one draw.

title.en: What a man with psychopathic traits wants people to understand about empathy
title.zh: 一个有精神病特征的人希望人们理解什么是同理心

summary.en: While some people might be born with or develop certain traits, experts say it doesn’t mean they're destined for harmful behaviour.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自澳洲栏目的新闻，重点涉及和平与克制。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
Share your feedback and help us improve this feature. Read more about how we use AI at SBS here.

A man diagnosed with psychopathic traits, parents concerned about their children's violent behaviour, and guests who grew up believing they were bad. Are some of us born bad, or is harmful behaviour shaped by experience? How do nature and nurture influence our choices and morals? Watch Insight episode Born Bad? at 8.30PM Tuesday 1 September on SBS or SBS On Demand.

Loïc De Marie says he views a human as "a rock" and has struggled to understand other people's emotions from a young age.

"A little classmate died in a dramatic car accident when I was six years old … everybody was crying," the 26-year-old told Insight.

"This [was] the first time I understood that emotions are different with me [because] the look that the teacher gave me was, 'Why is this kid not crying?'"

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

Growing up in Belgium, in that same year, Loïc and his little sister were playing near their backyard pool when she fell in.

"She was drowning, and I looked at her, and that was kind of troubling," he said.

He then saved her by holding out a plastic golf club for her to grab as he dragged her back to the ladder.

As he grew older, Loïc became increasingly involved in fights and would have angry outbursts.

"A guy was looking me in the eyes, some rivalry between men… and one day, I came to school with a baseball bat," he said.

Loïc says the police arrested him on the school grounds over the incident but says he never faced serious legal consequences.

Three years ago, Loïc began seeing a new psychologist — having grown tired of masking his thought processes.

The psychologist diagnosed him with antisocial personality disorder (ASPD) and documented traits associated with psychopathy — including manipulation and lying, a reckless disregard for other people's safety, and a lack of remorse and empathy.

"Everybody in the room can understand the words of the music and the melody ... I don't hear the melody — I don't understand it."

Loïc's father, Philippe, says he used to worry his son would go down the wrong path, but receiving a diagnosis was helpful.

"It [was] good to put a name on a disorder, and then you understand a lot of things.

"We try to ... do the best we can to support him [with] a lot of communication and love."

Forensic psychiatrist Dr Rajan Darjee, who has worked in prisons, mental health hospitals and in the community, says ASPD is a broad concept describing "people who, because of personality problems, are repeatedly breaking rules".

title.en: Has justice been done in Zomi Frankcom's case? Israel's history raises doubts
title.zh: Zomi Frankcom 的案件得到了正义的伸张吗？以色列的历史令人怀疑

summary.en: An investigation into Zomi Frankcom's death is closed. But important questions remain unanswered.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自澳洲栏目的新闻，重点涉及公义、尊严与问责。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
Share your feedback and help us improve this feature. Read more about how we use AI at SBS here.

In the case of Zomi Frankcom , an Australian killed in a drone strike while delivering humanitarian aid to the Gaza Strip in 2024, Israel's military justice system has concluded there is no reasonable suspicion of criminal misconduct.

It announced this month its decision to close the investigation into the death of Frankcom and six other World Central Kitchen (WCK) colleagues.

Israel's ambassador to Australia, Hillel Newman, said there had been no intention to attack the aid workers and a "reasonable mistake" was made.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

"There are tragic circumstances in a war zone and we're very sorry for the family, but that does not always mean that there's criminal liability," Newman told ABC Radio National.

Two Israel Defense Forces (IDF) officers were removed from their positions over the incident and another three were formally reprimanded.

But Foreign Minister Penny Wong has criticised the decision, noting "there are still many unanswered questions".

The Frankcom family and WCK are demanding an independent investigation into the airstrikes, saying "the IDF cannot credibly investigate its own conduct".

The case raises questions about whether Israel's military justice system is capable of delivering fair outcomes when its forces are accused of killing civilians, and where the line lies between a tragic operational error and conduct that warrants criminal investigation.

Michelle Burgis-Kasthala, professor of international law at La Trobe University, says there is "very compelling documentation" from many human rights organisations to suggest a "pattern of impunity" when it comes to the investigation of war crimes in Israel.

"A lot of the time they simply lapse and very rarely do they ever result in any form of criminal investigation, and even less likely [to result in] criminal conviction."

Last year, Action on Armed Violence (AOAV) looked at 52 publicly reported incidents in English-language media between October 2023 and June 2025, in which the Israeli media either reported an investigation was underway, or serious allegations of civilian harm.

The London-based charity found 88 per cent were either still under review or had been closed without any finding of wrongdoing.

So far, according to the cases examined by AOAV, only one case has resulted in a prison sentence against the accused.

title.en: 'Unsafe': Why Barnaby Joyce invoked Nepal to explain One Nation's refugee policy
title.zh: “不安全”：巴纳比·乔伊斯援引受灾的尼泊尔解释“一国党”的难民政策

summary.en: One Nation MP Barnaby Joyce suggested that Australia should not accept refugees from countries deemed unsafe for Australians to visit, citing flood-hit Nepal as an example.
summary.zh: “一国党”议员巴纳比·乔伊斯建议，澳大利亚不应接收来自政府认为对澳大利亚人来说不安全的国家的难民，并以遭受洪灾的尼泊尔为例。

body.en:
One Nation MP Barnaby Joyce has suggested that Australia should not accept refugees from countries that the government deems unsafe for Australians to visit, invoking flood-hit Nepal as an example.

Appearing on News24 (formerly Sky News) on Sunday morning, Joyce was asked whether Australia's current humanitarian intake should be cut.

Joyce brought up Nepal, which is reeling from catastrophic mudslides and flash flooding that have killed nearly 700 people. More than 3,000 more are missing, including 43 Australians.

"The refugee program has got to work within a policy structure we've got," Joyce said.

"Remember, we've clearly stated that if an area, the Department of Foreign Affairs (DFAT) says it's too unsafe to go there, then it's unsafe to bring people from there and away from there, such as places in Nepal.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

"I presume that the Department of Foreign Affairs says it's not unsafe to go to Nepal, but I wouldn't be going there at the moment."

Asked whether One Nation would stop accepting people from Nepal if DFAT were to advise against travel there, Joyce said he wasn't clear on DFAT's current position on the country, but "I know the Nepalese community have a huge say in sections of our country in the workforce, but they do it within the visa category."

"If they do come in, they'll be within the NOM," he added, referring to net overseas migration.

People who arrive on humanitarian visas currently contribute to net overseas migration figures.

While natural disasters can make a country unsafe to visit, people displaced by disasters do not generally qualify as refugees on that basis alone.

DFAT's latest travel advice for Nepal encourages a "high degree of caution due to the risk of natural disasters and road accidents". For certain areas closer to the disaster-hit region, it advises Australians to reconsider their need to travel.

Pressed on whether One Nation was happy with the current annual humanitarian intake level of 20,000, Joyce repeated that "it fits within the NOM".

"That is our policy, and the refugee policy — it's not that it's dispensed — but you can't come from countries which are dangerous. Like if you can't go there, you shouldn't be coming here."

Reporting suggested this week that the government intended to slash Australia's humanitarian intake by a third, however, Prime Minister Anthony Albanese said on Thursday that humanitarian placements would remain at 20,000.

On Sunday, Social Services Minister Tanya Plibersek said that was a "permanent commitment".

There has been ongoing confusion over the specifics of One Nation's broader immigration policy.

title.en: Australia should look 'very seriously' at UK-style ban on strangulation porn: minister
title.zh: 澳大利亚部长：应“非常认真地”考虑效仿英国禁止勒颈色情内容

summary.en: Social Services Minister Tanya Plibersek says the government is considering further reforms around online safety and should be looking "very seriously" at following the United Kingdom's lead by outlawing depictions of strangulation in pornography. Her comments follow the recent death of a 16-year-old girl after a...
summary.zh: 社会服务部长坦尼娅·普利伯塞克表示，政府正在考虑进一步改革网络安全，并应“非常认真地”考虑效仿英国，将色情内容中描绘勒颈的行为定为非法。她的评论是在一名16岁女孩因涉嫌性勒颈行为死亡后发表的。这起死亡事件重新引发了人们对年轻人性暴力发生率上升的担忧。

body.en:
Social Services Minister Tanya Plibersek says the government is considering further reforms around online safety and should be looking "very seriously" at following the United Kingdom's lead by outlawing depictions of strangulation in pornography.

Her comments follow the recent death of a 16-year-old girl after a suspected sexual strangulation act.

The death has sparked renewed concern over the rising rate of sexual violence among young people.

According to the Breathless campaign, strangulation — often referred to as "choking" — has become a common sexual practice for young Australians.

The campaign found 57 per cent of young Australians reported being strangled by a partner during sex, while 51 per cent said they had strangled a partner during sex. Among women, 61 per cent said they had experienced strangulation during sex.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

Last year, the UK government moved to criminalise porn featuring strangulation or suffocating, introducing a bill that would make it illegal to create or share any such content.

It was recommended in a UK government-commissioned review of online pornography, which found that dangerous practices were being normalised, particularly for young people, through porn.

New South Wales Liberal leader Kellie Sloane has written to Prime Minister Anthony Albanese to call for a similar ban in Australia.

"When pornography depicts an act capable of causing brain injury, unconsciousness or death, it should not be treated as just another form of adult entertainment," she said in a statement on Sunday.

Speaking on ABC's Insiders, Plibersek said the government should look seriously at such a ban.

"There is something wrong with a situation where 60 per cent of young people say they've experienced strangulation during sexual encounters," the federal minister said.

Plibersek said it would be crucial to educate young people that pornography is not real life.

"We know that children as young as 10 are seeing pornography before they've had their first kiss; they're getting their sex education from pornography," she said.

The government has already introduced age restrictions for social media and pornography in a bid to limit what young people view online, though concerns have been raised about loopholes .

Federal Education Minister Jason Clare announced on Sunday that the federal government would review the existing consent and respectful relationships program in schools to determine whether it needs strengthening.

Last week, three teen students were charged with the sexual assault of a 14-year-old girl in Bondi, and three boys were charged with the sexual assault of a 17-year-old girl in a...

title.en: Warning for WhatsApp users as hijacking scams jump
title.zh: 劫持诈骗猖獗，向 WhatsApp 用户发出警告

summary.en: Police have issued a fresh warning over a sharp rise in WhatsApp account hijacking scams, stressing that a recent dip in total monetary losses should not be mistaken as improved security. The force said it had handled 1,993 such cases between January and July, up 170 percent...
summary.zh: 这是一则来自香港栏目的新闻，重点涉及和平与克制。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en: Police have issued a fresh warning over a sharp rise in WhatsApp account hijacking scams, stressing that a recent dip in total monetary losses should not be mistaken as improved security. The force said it had handled 1,993 such cases between January and July, up 170 percent year-on-year. The seven-month figure already eclipsed the total of 1,669 last year. Victims this year reported aggregate losses of HK$146.3 million. While that was down 22.7 percent from the same period in 2025, authorities warned against complacency. Most victims suffered losses ranging from a few thousand to tens of thousands of dollars. But some were conned out of millions of dollars, or even more than HK$10 million. Chief Inspector Alvin Wong, from the Cyber Security and Technology Crime Bureau, said the scammers relied on a simple trick. "We found that is nothing related to any new technology used by the scammer, they use the same technology by sending the push SMS," he said. "WhatsApp's got a very large market share in Hong Kong and is commonly used by Hongkongers, and that's why the WhatsApp hijacking is the most market share in our hijacking cases." Wong said that victims would receive a text message claiming their account was about to be suspended or had a problem, and they must act immediately or face a penalty. Users who clicked on an embedded hyperlink would then expose their accounts to scammers, allowing them to access chat histories, impersonate trusted contacts, and eventually seek payments under different disguises. Police urged the public to avoid accessing suspicious links or QR codes, or sharing verification codes. Before transferring money, users must also scrutinise the recipient's account, and treat unfamiliar e-wallet or third-party requests as major red flags. WhatsApp owner, Meta, said it is devoted to fighting fraud, with AI tools deployed to detect suspicious activity. Philip Chua, the company's Asia‑Pacific policy director for products, said that account hijacking was especially serious. He said the breach allowed criminals to gather personal information and compromise more accounts, setting the stage for "potentially more criminal activity down the road". Chua stressed that the fraudsters' tactics will keep evolving, but the overriding message for users is simple: be alert, think twice, and double-check through other platforms before taking any action. On the technology front, he noted that AI is already helping Meta proactively remove accounts and block suspicious device linking. Edited by Raymond Yeung
body.zh: 警方针对 WhatsApp 账户劫持诈骗的急剧增加发出了新的警告，并强调最近总金钱损失的下降不应被误认为是安全性的改善。警方表示，今年 1 月至 7 月期间已处理此类案件 1,993 起，同比增长 170%。这七个月的数字已经超过了去年 1,669 的总数。今年受害人报告的总损失达1.463亿港元。尽管比 2025 年同期下降了 22.7%，但当局警告不要自满。大多数受害者遭受的损失从几千到数万美元不等。但也有一些人被骗走数百万美元，甚至超过1000万港元。网络安全及科技罪案调查科总督察 Alvin Wong 表示，诈骗者采用了一个简单的伎俩。 “我们发现这与诈骗者使用的任何新技术无关，他们通过发送推送短信来使用相同的技术，”他说。 “WhatsApp在香港拥有非常大的市场份额，并且被香港人普遍使用，这就是为什么WhatsApp劫持是我们劫持案件中市场份额最多的原因。”黄说，受害者会收到一条短信，声称他们的帐户即将被暂停或出现问题，他们必须立即采取行动，否则将面临处罚。点击嵌入的超链接的用户会将他们的帐户暴露给诈骗者，使他们能够访问聊天记录、冒充可信联系人，并最终以不同的伪装寻求付款。警方敦促公众避免访问可疑链接或二维码，或共享验证码。在转账之前，用户还必须仔细检查收款人的帐户，并将不熟悉的电子钱包或第三方请求视为主要危险信号。 WhatsApp 所有者 Meta 表示，该公司致力于打击欺诈行为，并部署了人工智能工具来检测可疑活动。该公司亚太区产品政策总监 Philip Chua 表示，账户劫持现象尤其严重。他表示，此次违规行为使犯罪分子能够收集个人信息并泄露更多账户，为“未来可能发生更多犯罪活动”奠定了基础。 Chua 强调，欺诈者的策略将不断演变，但向用户传达的最重要的信息很简单：保持警惕，三思而后行，并在采取任何行动之前通过其他平台仔细检查。在技​​术方面，他指出人工智能已经在帮助 Meta 主动删除帐户并阻止可疑设备链接。杨雷蒙编辑

title.en: T1 likely as tropical cyclone approaches
title.zh: 热带气旋逼近时可能出现 T1

summary.en: The Observatory said it may consider issuing the the Standby Signal No. 1 on Monday, as tropical cyclone Saudel may intensify into a tropical depression as it edges towards the South China Sea and eastern Guangdong. The low pressure system is expected to move across the northern...
summary.zh: 这是一则来自香港栏目的新闻，重点涉及和平与克制。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en: The Observatory said it may consider issuing the the Standby Signal No. 1 on Monday, as tropical cyclone Saudel may intensify into a tropical depression as it edges towards the South China Sea and eastern Guangdong. The low pressure system is expected to move across the northern part of the South China Sea and gradually edge closer to the coast of eastern Guangdong on Tuesday and Wednesday. "According to the present forecast, the remnant of Saudel will move towards the vicinity of the coast of southeastern Hainan Island around this evening, and intensify gradually into a tropical depression," the forecaster said. Under its combined effect with the northeast monsoon, it will be windier over Hong Kong during the day on Tuesday and Wednesday. "The Observatory will closely monitor its movement and the changes in local wind conditions, and assess the need for issuance of higher tropical cyclone warning signals," it added. It said there will be more showers over parts of the territory with squally thunderstorms on Tuesday, urging members of the public to take note of the latest weather information before going out for school or work. Edited by Raymond Yeung

summary.en: Betty Ho is adamant that she will not sell her flat in Wang Fuk Court under a government buyout scheme that is due to expire on Monday afternoon. Nine months have passed since the blaze that killed 168 people and displaced thousands from the Tai Po housing estate. An independent...
summary.zh: 这是一则来自香港栏目的新闻，重点涉及盼望、忍耐与重建。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en: Betty Ho is adamant that she will not sell her flat in Wang Fuk Court under a government buyout scheme that is due to expire on Monday afternoon. Betty Ho says she will not sell her flat in the fire-hit Wang Fuk Court under a government buyout scheme. Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. Nine months have passed since the blaze that killed 168 people and displaced thousands from the Tai Po housing estate . An independent committee is still preparing its final report on what caused the fire and how the systemic failures it exposed can be addressed. Meanwhile, 1,984 households have until 5pm on Monday to accept the government’s acquisition offer. Most homeowners have already accepted their terms. By last Thursday, 96.5 per cent of homeowners had signed a letter indicating that they were willing to sell their flat under the official plan, either for a cash pay-out or in return for a new unit in another government-subsidised development, according to official data. A little more than three-quarters have also taken the next step in the process, signing a formal sales agreement. But Ho, who bought a flat in Wang Shing House under her mother’s name in 1991, is one of those insisting that the government rebuild the estate on its original site for those who wish to return – a demand firmly rejected by the authorities, on the grounds that it would take a decade to rebuild. The government’s letter of acquisition addressed to Wang Fuk Court owners. Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. “We have always demanded on-site redevelopment, but we also know they won’t do it,” Ho said in Cantonese. The government has said that the August 31 deadline will not be extended, and it has not ruled out using “legislative means” to deal with remaining unsold flats in the future. As the deadline approached, some residents felt forced into submission. They said they were worried about their future housing, and feared that they would be forced to surrender their property by law if they declined to sell. “I feel helpless. I know that many of us don’t want to sign [the agreement],” Woo, a Wang Yan House resident who asked to be identified only by her surname, told HKFP in Cantonese. “We don’t know what we can do.” Wang Fuk Court resident Woo said she felt “helpless” with the government’s acquisition offer of her family’s flat. Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. With the buyout deadline looming, unsold properties now risk becoming “nail houses” – a Chinese term for holdouts who refuse to make way for development, often ending up isolated, cut off from utilities, and subjected to legal battles and harassment. Anthony Cheung, a public administration scholar who served as secretary for transport and housing from 2012 to 2017, said legislation for compulsory acquisition...

title.en: AFCD conducts control checks after dog attacks
title.zh: 渔护署在狗只袭击事件后进行管制检查

summary.en: The Agriculture, Fisheries and Conservation Department (AFCD) conducted spot checks across the city on Sunday, following recent fatal incidents involving dog attacks on people and other canines. The initiative is part of a broader push to reinforce proper dog control in public...
summary.zh: 这是一则来自香港栏目的新闻，重点涉及和平与克制。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en: The Agriculture, Fisheries and Conservation Department (AFCD) conducted spot checks across the city on Sunday, following recent fatal incidents involving dog attacks on people and other canines. The initiative is part of a broader push to reinforce proper dog control in public spaces and prevent further tragedies resulting from lax supervision. At West Kowloon, AFCD officers held up placards reading "Please put your pets on leash", while distributing promotional leaflets and reminding owners to keep their dogs securely restrained. Dog owner Wong, who was at the West Kowloon waterfront, said he believes the public is largely unafraid of dogs, provided they are properly managed. As the owner of a large breed, he stressed that he always keeps his dog leashed and under strict control in public. However, he questioned the long-term effectiveness of sporadic spot checks. "Sporadic inspections like this aren't really going to fundamentally solve the problem. Most of the time, it really comes down to owners being self-disciplined," he said. Another owner echoed the sentiment, suggesting that the majority of pet owners already exercise good discipline. "If we have an aggressive dog, us owners usually already know. So in fact, most dog owners – they are quite self-disciplined, from what I see. There's no intention to deliberately make places dirty, or deliberately attack other dogs – there really isn't any of that," she said. Meanwhile the AFCD said in a social media post that it had recently seized a suspected fighting dog. It said the animal has been taken for further veterinary observation and a temperament assessment. Edited by Aaron Tam
body.zh: 继最近发生狗攻击人类和其他犬类的致命事件后，渔农自然护理署（AFCD）周日在全市进行了抽查。该举措是加强公共场所对狗的适当控制并防止监管松懈造成进一步悲剧的更广泛努力的一部分。在西九龙，渔护署人员举着“请拴住宠物”的标语牌，同时派发宣传单张，提醒业主妥善拴住狗只。西九龙海旁的狗主人黄说，他相信公众基本上不害怕狗，只要它们得到妥善管理。作为一个大型犬种的主人，他强调，他在公共场合总是用皮带拴住自己的狗并受到严格控制。不过，他对零星抽查的长期有效性提出质疑。 “像这样的零星检查并不能真正从根本上解决问题。大多数时候，这实际上取决于业主的自律，”他说。另一位主人也表达了同样的观点，认为大多数宠物主人已经遵守了良好的纪律。 “如果我们有一只具有攻击性的狗，我们的主人通常已经知道了。所以事实上，大多数狗主人——在我看来，他们都是相当自律的。他们无意故意弄脏地方，或者故意攻击其他狗——确实没有这些，”她说。与此同时，渔护署在社交媒体上发帖称，最近抓获了一只疑似斗犬。据称，这只动物已被带去接受进一步的兽医观察和性格评估。谭咏麟编辑

title.zh: 尼泊尔和中国洪水失踪人数突破3000人 救援人员挖掘隧道

summary.en: Rescuers in Nepal and China battled Sunday through leg-sucking mud and the threat of rising rivers and a newly formed lake to search for thousands missing after a deadly wall of water and debris swept through the Himalayas, engulfing entire villages. Latest figures from both...
summary.zh: 这是一则来自香港栏目的新闻，重点涉及对脆弱群体的怜悯。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en: Rescuers in Nepal and China battled Sunday through leg-sucking mud and the threat of rising rivers and a newly formed lake to search for thousands missing after a deadly wall of water and debris swept through the Himalayas, engulfing entire villages. A team of Nepal police and National Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Authority (NDRRMA) retrieves money and documents from a bank covered in sludge in the aftermath of flash floods at Trishuli in Nepal’s Nuwakot district on August 30, 2026. Photo: Arun Sankar/AFP. Latest figures from both countries put the number of missing at 3,044 , with a further 750 confirmed deaths — and reports of some bodies possibly swept downstream as far away as India. The disaster, which struck the China-Nepal border Wednesday morning, was caused by a glacial collapse, sending a wall of water and debris downstream, the US Geological Survey said. Chinese rescuers near the Tibet border port that was hit by a deadly mudslide were “moved to a safe location” Sunday, after a new lake was formed by a landslide, state media reported. Nepali army troops and engineers were working on Sunday to rescue workers believed trapped in a tunnel at the Trishuli 3A hydroelectric site after they successfully inserted a pipe into the passage. They have “started sending air through the small opening”, Nepali Home Minister Sudan Gurung said in a statement. Embed from Getty Images Overnight rain and rising river waters hampered efforts early Sunday, filling the excavation area with water before conditions eased and teams resumed efforts, the Nepal army said. In an area home to vast energy infrastructure projects, Nepal’s disaster authority listed 933 hydropower workers among the missing. China’s state news agency Xinhua reported on Sunday that experts had said “a glacier on the southern slope of Lirung Peak in Nepal” fractured, triggering an ice-rock avalanche. It said the torrent plummeted rapidly, forming a massive debris flow that travelled more than 20 kilometres before crashing into Gyirong Port. “The sudden glacial collapse and flash flood is a devastating reminder of how fragile these mountain environments can be,” UN climate chief Simon Steill said in a statement. ‘Nothing left’ Survivors face an agonising wait to learn the fate of missing relatives and the prospect of rebuilding their lives from nothing. “All the settlements near the river were swept away,” Buddhi Ram Dangol told AFP in Nepal’s Nuwakot district. “There is nothing left.” At an army base serving as a rescue hub in Bidur, relatives crowded around lists of rescued people pasted on a wall. “I have come here looking for my son,” said Kalka Sharda,...
body.zh: 周日，一道致命的水墙和碎片席卷喜马拉雅山，吞没了整个村庄，尼泊尔和中国的救援人员在泥泞、河流上涨和新形成的湖泊的威胁下奋力搜寻数千名失踪人员。 2026 年 8 月 30 日，尼泊尔努瓦科特地区 Trishuli 发生山洪，尼泊尔警察和国家减少灾害风险管理局 (NDRRMA) 组成的团队从一家被污泥覆盖的银行取回资金和文件。照片：Arun Sankar/法新社。两国的最新数据显示，失踪人数为 3,044 人，另有 750 人确诊死亡，据报道，一些尸体可能被冲到下游，远至印度。美国地质调查局称，周三上午发生在中国和尼泊尔边境的这场灾难是由冰川崩塌造成的，导致水墙和碎片向下游流动。据官方媒体报道，西藏边境口岸附近遭受致命泥石流袭击的中国救援人员周日“被转移到安全地点”，山体滑坡形成了一个新的湖泊。周日，尼泊尔军队和工程师正在努力营救据信被困在 Trishuli 3A 水电站隧道中的工人，他们成功地将一根管道插入通道。尼泊尔内政部长苏丹古隆在一份声明中表示，他们已经“开始通过小开口输送空气”。尼泊尔军方表示，夜间降雨和不断上涨的河水阻碍了周日早些时候的工作，在情况缓解且工作人员恢复工作之前，挖掘区域已被水淹没。在一个拥有大型能源基础设施项目的地区，尼泊尔救灾当局将 933 名水电工人列为失踪人员。中国官方通讯社新华社周日报道称，专家表示，“尼泊尔利隆峰南坡的一座冰川”破裂，引发了冰岩雪崩。据称，洪流急速下降，形成巨大泥石流，行程20多公里，冲入吉隆口岸。联合国气候变化负责人西蒙·斯泰尔在一份声明中表示：“突然的冰川崩塌和山洪爆发毁灭性地提醒人们，这些山区环境是多么脆弱。” “一无所有”幸存者面临着痛苦的等待，他们想了解失踪亲人的命运，以及从一无所有中重建生活的前景。尼泊尔努瓦科特地区的布迪·拉姆·丹戈尔（Buddhi Ram Dangol）告诉法新社：“河流附近的所有定居点都被冲走了。” “什么都没有剩下了。”在比杜尔的一个作为救援中心的军事基地，亲属们围在墙上贴着的获救人员名单周围。 “我来这里是为了寻找我的儿子，”卡尔卡·沙达说……

title.en: China tightens rules on selling unfinished homes to lift sector
title.zh: 中国收紧销售未完工房屋的规定以提振行业

summary.en: Chinese officials tightened the rules for selling unfinished homes on Friday as they try to lift the country’s property market out of a years-long slump that has weighed on consumption. Half-built apartment buildings dot cities across China, relics of a property boom that came...
summary.zh: 这是一则来自香港栏目的新闻，重点涉及管家责任、供应与公共福祉。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en: Chinese officials tightened the rules for selling unfinished homes on Friday as they try to lift the country’s property market out of a years-long slump that has weighed on consumption. File photo: Shuxuan Cao, via Pexels. Half-built apartment buildings dot cities across China, relics of a property boom that came to a halt when the government clamped down on excessive borrowing and rampant speculation in 2020. That left several developers grappling with massive debt — wreaking havoc on buyers who poured their savings into new homes that were never finished. Chinese officials instructed local authorities on Friday to “vigorously and orderly promote the sale of ready-to-move-in commercial housing”, while they also urged more protections for buyers who purchase homes before construction is complete. The instructions came in a joint statement from China’s National Financial Regulatory Administration, as well as Beijing’s housing and natural resource ministries. The financial regulator and China’s central bank also announced on Friday new lending guidelines that raise the maximum length for personal housing loans to 40 years, from the existing 30-year mortgage limit. “These policies are a meaningful step in the right direction,” wrote Zhiwei Zhang, President and Chief Economist at Pinpoint Asset Management. The Great Hall of the People in Beijing. Photo: Lukas Messmer/HKFP. “The decision to allow mortgage loans up to 40 years helps to mitigate the home buyers’ debt burden,” he said. China’s leaders have battled sluggish domestic spending since the end of the Covid-19 pandemic, which has threatened growth even as exports and certain high-tech sectors boom. “The weak domestic demand is to a large extent due to the troubled property sector,” Zhang said, adding that the new housing policies showed officials “understand the urgency” to stabilise the market.
body.zh: 中国官员周五收紧了销售未完工房屋的规定，试图使中国房地产市场摆脱多年来拖累消费的低迷状态。资料照片：曹树轩，来自 Pexels。半建的公寓楼遍布中国各地的城市，这是房地产热潮的遗迹，随着政府在 2020 年打击过度借贷和猖獗的投机活动，房地产热潮陷入停滞。这让一些开发商陷入巨额债务的困境，这对那些将积蓄投入到从未完工的新房的买家造成了严重破坏。中国官员周五指示地方当局“大力有序促进商品房预售”，同时他们还敦促为在工程竣工前购房的购房者提供更多保护。这些指示是在中国国家金融监督管理局以及北京住建部和自然资源部的联合声明中发布的。金融监管机构和中国央行周五还宣布了新的贷款指导方针，将个人住房贷款的最长期限从现有的 30 年抵押贷款期限提高到 40 年。 “这些政策是朝着正确方向迈出的有意义的一步，”品点资产管理公司总裁兼首席经济学家张志伟写道。北京人民大会堂。照片：Lukas Messmer/HKFP。 “允许抵押贷款期限长达 40 年的决定有助于减轻购房者的债务负担，”他说。自Covid-19大流行结束以来，中国领导人一直在与国内支出低迷作斗争，尽管出口和某些高科技行业蓬勃发展，但国内支出仍威胁着经济增长。张说：“内需疲软在很大程度上是由于房地产行业陷入困境。”他补充说，新的住房政策表明官员“理解”稳定市场的紧迫性。

reflection.en: This story draws attention to stewardship, provision, and the common good. 1 Peter 4:10 reminds us to meet sharp headlines with stewardship that serves neighbours, asking how faithful people can respond with wisdom instead of noise.
reflection.zh: 这则新闻让人想到管家责任、供应与公共福祉。1 Peter 4:10提醒我们，在快速变化的新闻里，仍要以服事邻舍的好管家心态来回应，并学习用祷告与分辨代替情绪化判断。

verse.textEn: Whatever you do, work at it with all your heart, as working for Yahweh, not for human masters.
verse.textZh: 无论做什么，都要从心里做，像是给主做的，不是给人做的。

title.en: Number of missing in Nepal, China floods soars to nearly 3,000
title.zh: 尼泊尔、中国洪涝失踪人数飙升至近3000人

summary.en: Rescuers in Nepal and China were still battling Saturday to locate thousands of people missing days after a deadly, tsunami-like wall of water and debris swept through the Himalayan region, engulfing villages. The number of missing soared close to 3,000 Saturday, latest figures...
summary.zh: 这是一则来自香港栏目的新闻，重点涉及对脆弱群体的怜悯。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en: Rescuers in Nepal and China were still battling Saturday to locate thousands of people missing days after a deadly, tsunami-like wall of water and debris swept through the Himalayan region, engulfing villages. A woman looks at photographs of the missing and dead following flash floods in Nepal, outside a hospital in Kathmandu on August 29, 2026. Photo: Prakash Mathema/AFP. The number of missing soared close to 3,000 Saturday, latest figures from both countries showed, with 633 bodies recovered — and reports of some dead possibly swept downstream as far away as India. In an area home to vast energy infrastructure projects, Nepal’s disaster authority added 933 hydropower workers to a missing persons list already including trekkers and pilgrims to Tibet’s sacred Mount Kailash. Those that made it out say they have lost everything and now face an agonising wait to discover the fate of missing loved ones, and the prospect of rebuilding their lives from nothing. “All the settlements near the river were swept away. There is nothing left,” survivor Buddhi Ram Dangol told AFP. Samjhana Thing said she had been waiting three days for news of her missing brother. Satellite image showing the aftermath of the China-Nepal flash flood, which occurred on Wednesday, August 26, 2026. Photo: Vantor via CC BY-NC 4.0. “We don’t know anything. Hopefully he is in a safe place,” she said. ‘Enormous’ trauma The trauma of Wednesday’s catastrophe has been “enormous”, and as many as 93,000 people may have been affected, the Red Cross said, with the death toll expected to rise. Emergency teams had been racing to retrieve survivors from affected zones, where the widespread devastation meant food and water supplies were running out. Compounding the search for the missing have been fears of further flooding in affected areas. The deluge of ice and mud caused huge lakes to form, and one of these formations has become a direct threat to emergency workers scouring the region for survivors. Embed from Getty Images Nepali police urged all rescuers to “immediately move to a safe location”, saying they had received information that “a water dam has burst again on the Tibetan side”. In Tibet, where Chinese authorities are the only source of information, Beijing suspended its rescue operation at the hardest-hit area of Gyirong over the risk of renewed flooding, before saying the threat had eased. State news agency Xinhua reported early Saturday morning that two villagers had been rescued in the area. ‘All swept away’ On the Nepali side of the border, the military located people trapped in the tunnel of the Trishuli 3A hydropower project, where they were working to find a way in...
body.zh: 周六，尼泊尔和中国的救援人员仍在努力寻找数千名失踪人员，几天前，一场致命的海啸般的水墙和残骸席卷了喜马拉雅地区，吞没了村庄。 2026 年 8 月 29 日，加德满都一家医院外，一名妇女正在查看尼泊尔山洪爆发后失踪者和死者的照片。照片：Prakash Mathema/法新社。两国最新数据显示，周六失踪人数飙升至近 3,000 人，已找到 633 具尸体，而有关部分死者的报道可能远至印度。在一个拥有大型能源基础设施项目的地区，尼泊尔灾害管理局将 933 名水电工人添加到失踪人员名单中，其中包括前往西藏圣山冈仁波齐的徒步旅行者和朝圣者。那些成功逃脱的人表示，他们失去了一切，现在面临着痛苦的等待，寻找失踪亲人的命运，以及白手起家重建生活的前景。幸存者Buddhi Ram Dangol告诉法新社：“河边的所有定居点都被冲走了。什么都没有留下。” Samjhana Thing 说，她已经等了三天才收到失踪弟弟的消息。卫星图像显示 2026 年 8 月 26 日星期三发生的中国-尼泊尔山洪爆发的后果。照片：Vantor，来自 CC BY-NC 4.0。 “我们什么都不知道。希望他在安全的地方，”她说。 “巨大”创伤 红十字会表示，周三灾难造成的创伤“巨大”，可能有多达 93,000 人受到影响，预计死亡人数还会上升。应急小组一直在努力从受影响地区救回幸存者，那里的大范围破坏意味着食物和水供应即将耗尽。由于担心受影响地区会进一步发生洪水，寻找失踪人员的工作变得更加复杂。大量的冰和泥浆形成了巨大的湖泊，其中一个湖泊已经成为紧急救援人员在该地区搜寻幸存者的直接威胁。尼泊尔警方敦促所有救援人员“立即转移到安全地点”，称他们收到“西藏一侧水坝再次决堤”的消息。在西藏，中国当局是唯一的信息来源。北京方面因担心再次发生洪水的风险而暂停了在吉隆县受灾最严重地区的救援行动，随后又表示威胁已经缓解。官方通讯社新华社周六凌晨报道称，两名村民在该地区获救。 “全部被冲走” 在边境的尼泊尔一侧，军方找到了被困在 Trishuli 3A 水电项目隧道中的人们，他们正在那里寻找出路……

verse.textZh: 我实在告诉你们，这些事你们既做在我这弟兄中一个最小的身上，就是做在我身上了。

title.en: The London stock market dodged a bullet with Shein | Nils Pratley
title.zh: 伦敦股市避开了 Shein 这颗“子弹”

summary.en: Shein, the Chinese fast-fashion giant, is set to list in Hong Kong with a reduced valuation after a potential London IPO stalled. Despite intense wooing by UK politicians seeking to revitalize the local market with 'tech adrenalin,' significant concerns regarding Shein's business model and ethical practices led to a...
summary.zh: 中国快时尚巨头 Shein 在伦敦上市计划搁置后，将转往香港上市，但估值有所缩水。尽管英国政界此前为了振兴当地市场而积极拉拢，希望注入“技术兴奋剂”，但由于对其商业模式和伦理实践存在重大疑虑，伦敦金融界对于未能成事反而感到一种解脱。

body.en: China’s fashion giant will list in Hong Kong with a shrunken price tag – and big questions over its business model In a parallel world, we might now be preparing for the arrival on the London stock market of Shein, the giant Chinese-founded fast-fashion retailer. Or it could have happened already. The possibility of a London flotation was a running story during 2024 and into last year as politicians from both main parties engaged in behind-the-scenes wooing. Shein was seen as a shot of tech adrenalin for a listless local listings scene, and an opportunity to advertise the UK’s openness to international capital. Continue reading...
body.zh: 中国时尚巨头将以更低的价格在香港上市——其商业模式面临重大质疑在另一个平行世界中，我们现在可能正在为中国创办的大型快时尚零售商 Shein 登陆伦敦股市做准备。或者它可能已经发生了。从 2024 年到去年，随着两大主要政党的政治家都在幕后拉拢，在伦敦上市的可能性一直是一个热门话题。 Shein 被视为为当地无精打采的上市场景注入一剂科技肾上腺素，也是宣传英国对国际资本开放的机会。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The pursuit of rapid economic growth often tempts leaders to overlook the long-term health and ethical foundations of their institutions. While the 'tech adrenalin' of a massive IPO is attractive, true prudence involves recognizing when a short-term gain carries risks that outweigh the benefits. Yahweh values the wisdom that looks beyond the surface of a...
reflection.zh: 对经济快速增长的追求往往诱使领导者忽视机构的长期健康和伦理基础。虽然大规模 IPO 带来的“技术兴奋剂”极具吸引力，但真正的谨慎在于识别短期利益何时携带了超过收益的风险。雅伟看重那种能看透“缩水的价格标签”表面、审视内在工作诚信的智慧。

verse.textEn: The prudent see danger and take refuge, but the simple keep going and pay the penalty.
verse.textZh: 通达人见祸藏躲；愚蒙人前往受害。

title.en: The Guardian view on the Tiananmen vigil convictions: Hong Kong too has been silenced. Others should speak out | Editorial
title.zh: 《卫报》评论天安门守夜活动定罪：香港也被噤声。其他人应发声 | 社论

summary.en: Two activists in Hong Kong face jail sentences for organizing commemorations of the 1989 Tiananmen Square crackdown. For decades, Hong Kong was the only place in China where the annual vigil could publicly keep the memory of the pro-democracy protests alive, but recent crackdowns have suppressed these freedoms.
summary.zh: 两名香港社运人士因组织纪念1989年天安门镇压的活动而面临牢狱之灾。几十年来，香港是中国唯一可以公开纪念天安门民主抗议活动的地方，但最近的镇压已经扼杀了这些自由。

body.en: Two activists who organised commemorations of the bloody crackdown on China’s 1989 pro-democracy protests now face jail. Remembering is not a crime For decades, Hong Kong mourned when the mainland could not. Its huge annual Tiananmen vigil kept alive the memory of the 1989 pro-reform protests in Beijing, and of the massacre that suppressed them. Along with Macau, it was the only place in China where the anniversary could be publicly marked and the truth preserved. But the crackdown on the 2019 uprising in Hong Kong has crushed the freedoms that the region once enjoyed. That year’s vigil was the last. On Friday, two leaders of the Hong Kong Alliance, which organised the commemoration, were convicted of incitement to subversion under the draconian national security law. Lee Cheuk-yan, 69, and Chow Hang-tung, 41, face up to 10 years in jail. Do you have an opinion on the issues raised in this article? If you would like to submit a response of up to 300 words by email to be considered for publication in our letters section, please click here . Continue reading...
body.zh: 两名组织纪念中国 1989 年血腥镇压民主抗议活动的活动人士现在面临牢狱之灾。铭记不是犯罪 几十年来，香港一直在哀悼，而大陆却无法铭记。一年一度的天安门守夜活动让人们牢牢记住了1989年北京支持改革的抗议活动以及镇压抗议活动的大屠杀。它与澳门一样，是中国唯一可以公开纪念这一周年并保存真相的地方。但2019年香港起义的镇压摧毁了该地区曾经享有的自由。那一年的守夜活动是最后一次。周五，组织这次纪念活动的香港联盟的两名领导人根据严厉的国家安全法被判犯有煽动颠覆罪。 69 岁的李卓人和 41 岁的周恒东将面临最高 10 年的监禁。您对本文提出的问题有什么看法吗？如果您想通过电子邮件提交最多 300 字的回复，以便考虑在我们的信件部分发布，请单击此处。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The conviction of two Hong Kong activists for organizing a Tiananmen vigil highlights the silencing of memory and dissent. Proverbs 31:8 calls us to "speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves," a principle embodied by those who sought to keep the truth of 1989 alive. As freedoms are crushed in Hong Kong, this story reminds us of the moral...
reflection.zh: 两名香港社运人士因组织天安门守夜活动而被定罪，这凸显了记忆和异议被压制的情况。箴言31:8呼吁我们“为不能自辩的人开口”，这正是那些努力让1989年真相得以存留的人所体现的原则。随着香港自由的被扼杀，这个故事提醒我们，其他人有道德义务为那些被噤声的人发声。

verse.textEn: Speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves, for the rights of all who are destitute. Speak up and judge fairly; defend the rights of the poor and needy.
verse.textZh: 你当为不能自辩的开口，为孤独的伸冤。你当开口按公义判断，为困苦和穷乏的辨屈。

title.en: ‘She’s not afraid of anyone’: the prison writings of one of Hong Kong’s last outspoken democracy activists
title.zh: “她不害怕任何人”：香港最后一位直言不讳的民主活动人士的监狱著作

summary.en: Chow Hang-tung has been detained since 2021, and written about everything from clothes to Tiananmen Square and the meaning of freedom Tiananmen Square vigil organisers in Hong Kong found guilty of ‘inciting subversion’ In one essay written from prison, Chow Hang-tung worries...
summary.zh: 这是一则来自香港栏目的新闻，重点涉及领导、智慧与公共责任。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

title.en: Using data to help wheat growers adapt to unpredictable weather

summary.en: For generations, wheat planting has followed predictable seasonal patterns. But this year, unseasonably warm weather in March and April accelerated wheat growth, pushing the crop into a vulnerable growth stage when widespread freezing temperatures hit.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自科学栏目的新闻，重点涉及真理、分辨与诚实。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
This article has been reviewed according to Science X's editorial process and policies . Editors have highlighted the following attributes while ensuring the content's credibility:

For generations, wheat planting has followed predictable seasonal patterns. But this year, unseasonably warm weather in March and April accelerated wheat growth, pushing the crop into a vulnerable growth stage when widespread freezing temperatures hit .

As weather becomes less predictable, choosing the right planting date has become more difficult. For wheat growers in Virginia, where tight margins already make every decision count, getting the timing right is a matter of survival.

"Wheat's low market price and high input costs have meant that Virginia's wheat acreage has declined in recent years," said Joseph Oakes, Eastern Virginia Agricultural Research and Extension Center (AREC) superintendent and Extension specialist.

As historical weather data show a shifting climate, tools to determine ideal planting dates are vital for growers to ensure enough warm days for sufficient yield while minimizing the potential for late-spring freezes.

"Research shows that plant development in the fall contributes to almost 90% of grain yield," Oakes said. "Leaving time for that growth is one of the most important things you can do for high wheat yields."

Research led by Oakes and Virginia Cooperative Extension agents Robbie Longest and Turner Minx offers growers a clearer path forward.

Working with farmers in King William, New Kent, Richmond and Westmoreland counties, the team compared four planting dates, from mid-October through November, using drone-based remote sensing to monitor crop growth throughout the season.

The drone-based methods were developed and validated as part of a USDA multistate grant to help farmers optimize fertilizer application in winter wheat and efficiently collect crop and field data. In this project, the team applied these monitoring and management technologies to evaluate planting dates for regional wheat growers.

The research showed how planting date can influence both yield and vulnerability to spring freezes. Planting before Nov. 1 showed no reduction in yield, giving growers confidence to shift planting dates later into October without sacrificing production. That timing gives crops enough warm weather to establish before winter while reducing the chance they will mature too early and be damaged by spring freezes. By contrast, wheat planted in November had less time to develop before winter, resulting in reduced growth and lower yields.

"It's critical to plant early enough to be established before winter, but not so early that advanced crops risk a devastating spring freeze," Oakes said. "Growers are getting squeezed on both sides: Prices are...

title.en: 'Cut-to-fuse' strategy: A new route for molecular skeletal editing
title.zh: “剪切融合”策略：分子骨架编辑的新途径

summary.en: Restructuring a molecule without rebuilding it from scratch is an increasingly important goal in modern organic chemistry. Skeletal editing is an approach that helps chemists explore new chemical structures and simplify the synthesis of molecules with potential pharmaceutical...
summary.zh: 这是一则来自科学栏目的新闻，重点涉及盼望、忍耐与重建。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
This article has been reviewed according to Science X's editorial process and policies . Editors have highlighted the following attributes while ensuring the content's credibility:

Restructuring a molecule without rebuilding it from scratch is an increasingly important goal in modern organic chemistry. Skeletal editing is an approach that helps chemists explore new chemical structures and simplify the synthesis of molecules with potential pharmaceutical applications.

But in the case of functional groups such as esters, skeletal editing remains difficult because their carbon–carbon and carbon–oxygen bonds are resistant to cleavage under mild conditions.

Now, a research team led by Professor Toshifumi Dohi of Ritsumeikan University, along with Yusuke Yoto, also of Ritsumeikan University, and Dr. Hideyasu China of Doshisha Women's College of Liberal Arts, developed a unique solution inspired by nature.

Their study, published in JACS Au on July 26, 2026, demonstrates that introducing chlorine into hydroxycoumarins can trigger a sequence of bond-cleavage and bond-forming events that removes a carbonyl group and reconstructs the molecule as a coumaranone.

"We aimed to develop a new way of editing molecular skeletons for esters, one that could break difficult bonds under mild conditions and immediately reconstruct the molecule into a useful framework," Dohi says.

The idea started from the team's interest in a "cut-to-fuse" strategy. In this concept, halogenation first "cuts" bonds in a cyclic compound, generating a reactive chain, before a subsequent intramolecular reaction "fuses" the chain into a new heterocyclic structure.

The researchers projected that a similar process might enable carbonyl deletion—the net removal of a carbonyl unit from hydroxycoumarins.

The initial experiments produced an unexpected result. The team had been investigating fluorine-induced carbon–carbon bond cleavage, but fluorination caused the hydroxycoumarin to fragment into separate products.

"Chlorine changed the reaction pathway completely," Dohi says. Treating a hydroxycoumarin with N -chlorosuccinimide (NCS) led to the formation of a chlorinated intermediate that underwent decarbonylative reconstruction, ultimately producing a coumaranone rather than fragmenting the molecule.

The researchers then optimized the reaction and found that the transformation could proceed at room temperature under near-neutral conditions without transition-metal catalysis. Under the optimized conditions, hydroxycoumarin was treated with NCS, water and sodium acetate in ethyl acetate, followed by potassium phosphate.

The method produced the model coumaranone in more than 99% yield. According to the researchers, this represents the mildest nonenzymatic conditions reported to date for...
body.zh: 本文已根据 Science X 的编辑流程和政策进行审阅。编辑在确保内容可信度的同时强调了以下属性： 重组分子而不从头开始重建是现代有机化学中日益重要的目标。骨架编辑是一种帮助化学家探索新的化学结构并简化具有潜在药物应用的分子合成的方法。 但对于酯类等官能团来说，骨架编辑仍然很困难，因为它们的碳-碳和碳-氧键在温和条件下不易断裂。 现在，由立命馆大学的 Toshifumi Dohi 教授、立命馆大学的 Yusuke Yoto 以及同志社女子文学院的 Hideyasu China 博士领导的研究小组开发了一种受大自然启发的独特解决方案。 他们的研究于 2026 年 7 月 26 日发表在《JACS Au》上，表明将氯引入羟基香豆素中可以触发一系列键断裂和成键事件，从而去除羰基并将分子重建为香豆酮。 “我们的目标是开发一种编辑酯分子骨架的新方法，这种方法可以在温和条件下打破困难的键，并立即将分子重建成有用的框架，”多希说。 这个想法源于团队对“自断熔断”策略的兴趣。在这个概念中，卤化首先“切断”环状化合物中的键，产生反应性链，然后进行后续的分子内反应，将该链“融合”成新的杂环结构。 研究人员预计，类似的过程可能会实现羰基删除，即从羟基香豆素中净去除羰基单元。 最初的实验产生了意想不到的结果。该团队一直在研究氟引起的碳-碳键断裂，但氟化导致羟基香豆素分裂成单独的产物。 “氯完全改变了反应途径，”多希说。用 N-氯代琥珀酰亚胺 (NCS) 处理羟基香豆素，形成氯化中间体，并进行脱羰基重建，最终产生香豆酮而不是使分子断裂。 研究人员随后对反应进行了优化，发现该转化可以在室温、近中性条件下进行，无需过渡金属催化。在优化的条件下，用NCS、水和乙酸钠的乙酸乙酯溶液处理羟基香豆素，然后用磷酸钾处理。 该方法生产模型香豆酮，产率超过 99%。据研究人员称，这代表了迄今为止报道的最温和的非酶条件……

title.en: Tides can be mapped much more locally using a new method based on satellite images
title.zh: 使用基于卫星图像的新方法可以更本地化地绘制潮汐图

summary.en: When high or low tide occurs, the water does not necessarily rise and fall uniformly along the entire coastline. In fact, the height of the tide in a bay can vary by up to one meter (3 feet) from one location to another just a few kilometers away.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自科学栏目的新闻，重点涉及受造之物关怀与环保责任。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
This article has been reviewed according to Science X's editorial process and policies . Editors have highlighted the following attributes while ensuring the content's credibility:

When high or low tide occurs, the water does not necessarily rise and fall uniformly along the entire coastline. In fact, the height of the tide in a bay can vary by up to one meter (3 feet) from one location to another just a few kilometers away.

This is shown in a new study published by researchers from DTU Space in collaboration with colleagues from the University of Oxford and the Technical University of Munich (TUM), as well as the German space technology company OHB. Together, they have analyzed satellite images taken over a period of more than 40 years by the U.S. Landsat program.

Typically, tides are measured using water level gauges located at specific sites or through satellite measurements of the sea surface. Especially in sparsely populated areas, this leaves large areas without direct measurements of tidal height along the coast.

"Typically, water level gauges are spaced 50 km (31 miles) apart or more, and measurements are then calculated from their values. With this method, we can instead use satellite images of the coastline to obtain a much more detailed picture of how tidal levels vary geographically along a given coastline," says Professor Ole Baltazar Andersen of DTU Space, a co-author of the study, which has been published in Communications Earth & Environment .

By tracking the boundary between land and water across thousands of satellite images and combining these data with information about the beach's slope, researchers can calculate changes in water level and thus tidal variations.

"Variations in the coastline have often been regarded as noise that needed to be removed from satellite data. Here, we show that this noise can instead be used as a signal to map tidal patterns on a very local scale," he says.

The extensive satellite data allow researchers to verify and improve existing tidal models, thereby contributing in the long term to more accurate local forecasts of high and low tides.

"The interesting thing is that we can use this new knowledge to improve the models. In the long run, this could give us better local tidal forecasts, even along coastal stretches where we currently have very few measurements," says Andersen.

This could be particularly significant in areas where traditional water level gauges are few and far between.

"In Denmark, we have many water level gauges and relatively small tidal variations, so here the method isn't quite as significant. But in Greenland, for example, it's completely different. There are only a handful of physical water level gauges, while the daily variation in the tides can be as much as five to...

title.en: 'A giant leap forward': Nasa launches powerful new space telescope
title.zh: “巨大飞跃”：美国宇航局发射强大的新型太空望远镜

summary.en: NASA has launched the Nancy Grace Roman Space Telescope, a next-generation observatory designed to map the universe and investigate the mysteries of dark energy and dark matter. With a field of view 100 times larger than its predecessors, the mission will also search for exoplanets from its vantage point one million...
summary.zh: 美国宇航局（NASA）发射了南希·格雷斯·罗曼太空望远镜，这是一台旨在绘制宇宙地图并研究暗能量和暗物质奥秘的新一代天文台。该望远镜的视野比其前身大100倍，其任务还包括在距离地球100万英里的观测点搜寻系外行星。

body.en:
Nasa's powerful next-generation telescope has blasted off into space from its launchpad in Florida, with a mission to explore dark energy, black holes and other mysteries of the Universe.

The Nancy Grace Roman telescope will capture vast panoramic views of space, with a field of vision 100 times larger than both the Hubble and James Webb space telescopes, Nasa says.

The mission begins with a 100-day journey to a vantage point roughly one million miles from Earth, where the telescope will then start charting planets outside our solar system, known as exoplanets.

"Roman is going to change the way we look at the Universe," said Nicky Fox, a Nasa administrator.

The successful launch of the telescope took place on Sunday morning local time from the Kennedy Space Center in Florida.

Jackie Townsend, a project manager on Nasa's Roman telescope, described it as "glorious" at a news conference afterwards. "The ride was magnificent. It put us right where we wanted to be."

About 30 minutes after launch, Roman separated from its SpaceX rocket and is now heading towards its orbiting point around a million miles away.

Fox said Roman "is going to discover tens of thousands, maybe even 100,000 new exoplanets" - referring to planets located outside of our solar system.

"Why do we care so much about exoplanets? Because one of our main goals at Nasa is answering the question, 'Are we alone in the universe'?" she added.

US President Donald Trump dialled in to the space agency's news conference to congratulate the scientists working on the project.

"You're the hottest in space, and we have the hottest country anywhere in the world. So, let's keep it all going. You're a big part of it," Trump said.

Astronomer Jenifer Millard said the telescope will be four times further from Earth than the Moon is, where a lot of infrared space cameras - made to pick up what she describes as "heat light"- operate.

She told the BBC this is to make sure infrared light from the Moon and Earth don't interfere with the cameras.

Nasa's James Webb Space Telescope, launched in 2021, also orbits the Sun around one million miles from Earth, but its field of vision is not as expansive. Nasa's Hubble Space Telescope, launched in 1990, orbits at about 300 miles above Earth's surface.

While Roman will look outward into the Universe, Millard said scientists are also anticipating it will find thousands of new worlds in our own galaxy.

The telescope is named after physicist Nancy Grace Roman, who was Nasa's first chief astronomer in the 1960s and its first female executive.

During her career, she was instrumental in getting the Hubble Space Telescope approved by US Congress and later said its most interesting discovery was dark energy.

The new telescope is similarly expected to...
body.zh: 美国宇航局强大的下一代望远镜已从佛罗里达州的发射台发射升空，其任务是探索暗能量、黑洞和宇宙的其他奥秘。 美国宇航局表示，南希·格雷斯·罗曼望远镜将捕捉广阔的太空全景，其视野比哈勃和詹姆斯·韦伯太空望远镜大100倍。 该任务从为期 100 天的旅程开始，到达距地球约 100 万英里的有利位置，然后望远镜将开始绘制太阳系外行星（称为系外行星）的图表。 “罗曼将改变我们看待宇宙的方式，”美国宇航局管理员尼基福克斯说。 该望远镜于当地时间周日上午在佛罗里达州肯尼迪航天中心成功发射。 美国宇航局罗马望远镜的项目经理杰基·汤森德在随后的新闻发布会上形容这是“光荣的”。 “这次旅程非常棒。它让我们到达了我们想去的地方。” 发射后约 30 分钟，Roman 与 SpaceX 火箭分离，目前正朝着约 100 万英里外的轨道点前进。 福克斯表示，罗曼“将发现数万颗，甚至可能是 10 万颗新的系外行星”——指的是位于太阳系之外的行星。 “为什么我们如此关心系外行星？因为美国宇航局的主要目标之一就是回答这个问题：‘我们在宇宙中孤独吗？’”她补充道。 美国总统唐纳德·特朗普拨通了航天局的新闻发布会，向从事该项目的科学家表示祝贺。 “你们是太空中最热门的国家，我们拥有世界上最热门的国家。所以，让我们继续努力。你们是其中的重要组成部分，”特朗普说。 天文学家詹妮弗·米勒德表示，这架望远镜距离地球的距离将是月球距离的四倍，月球上有许多红外太空相机，用于捕捉她所说的“热光”。 她告诉英国广播公司，这是为了确保来自月球和地球的红外光不会干扰相机。 美国宇航局 (NASA) 的詹姆斯·韦伯太空望远镜于 2021 年发射，也绕太阳运行，距地球约 100 万英里，但其视野没有那么广阔。美国宇航局的哈勃太空望远镜于 1990 年发射，其轨道距地球表面约 300 英里。 米勒德表示，虽然罗曼将向外观察宇宙，但科学家们也预计它将在我们自己的星系中发现数千个新世界。 该望远镜以物理学家南希·格雷斯·罗曼 (Nancy Grace Roman) 的名字命名，她是 20 世纪 60 年代美国宇航局第一位首席天文学家，也是第一位女性高管。 在她的职业生涯中，她在哈勃太空望远镜获得美国国会批准方面发挥了重要作用，后来表示其最有趣的发现是暗能量。 新望远镜同样有望...

reflection.en: The launch of the Roman telescope reminds us that our curiosity is a response to a universe that seems designed to be discovered. As we peer into the mysteries of space with a field of vision 100 times wider than before, we find that the vastness does not diminish human significance but rather highlights the majesty of Yahweh. Each new map of the stars is a...
reflection.zh: 罗曼望远镜的发射提醒我们，人类的好奇心是对这个似乎注定要被发现的宇宙的一种回应。当我们以比以往宽100倍的视野窥探太空的奥秘时，我们发现这种浩瀚并没有削弱人类的意义，反而彰显了雅伟的雄伟。每一份新的星图都是宇宙故事中崭新的一页，不断宣告着远超我们自身的荣耀。
